print(f'September increase: {sep_increase}')
print(f'Mean: {mean}')
print(f'Std dev: {std_dev}')
print(f'Z-score: {z_score}')
print(f'Rounded z-score: {round(z_score, 2)}')
print(f'Is unusual (z > 1.96)? {z_score > 1.96}')
"
